steps.text: 1. In the Publish step, the Contributor taps "Preview as a tourist". E1.

exceptions.text: E1. The tour has no places → 422 "Cannot preview yet: the tour needs at least one stop" with an "Add stop" button; an unconfigured route / zone does not block (it is generated).

steps.text: 2. The system (Tour) checks the author's rights and builds the data like the public page (places, photos, translations, route, effective zones). E2.

exceptions.text: E2. Someone else's tour → 403; the tour does not exist → 404.

steps.text: 3. The system opens the player in "Preview — simulated walk" mode, with the simulated position at the start of the route; no real GPS needed.
4. The Contributor starts the simulated walk (chooses a speed) or taps the map to move the position. A1.

5. When the position enters a trigger zone, the system plays that place as in UC#04 (higher priority zone first; recorded audio or the device's voice), shows the text, photos, the "next stop" suggestion and direction audio. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. The browser blocks sound or has no voice for the language → reports it and lets the user play again (as in UC#04).

steps.text: 6. The Contributor checks the content and changes the language if needed. A3.
7. The Contributor taps "Back to the Publish step" or "Back to the editor". A2.

steps: A1. Preview place by place: pick a place in the list to listen, without using the position.
A3. Change the listening language: the system reloads the preview in another language.
A2. An error is found → fix it at once: the edit button on a place opens UC#10; the route / zone is fixed in UC#11; translations are fixed in UC#12.
